interest_expense.label: Interest Expense
interest_expense.note: InterestExpense stops dead at CY2024Q2 and InterestExpenseOperating carries on from CY2023Q2. Same measure - all four overlapping quarters agree to the dollar (CY2023Q2 152,885,000 / CY2023Q3 156,723,000 / CY2024Q1 180,530,000 / CY2024Q2 200,124,000). Never pool a successor without checking the overlap; disagreement means different measures and splicing them invents a step that never happened.

dividends_per_share.label: Dividends Declared per Share
dividends_per_share.note: SEC tagged Q4 directly 2010-2019, then stopped. Q4 is derived from the annual figure from 2020 onward. Coincidental match with the EPS gap, not a related cause.

credit_loss_allowance.label: Credit Loss Allowance (AFS securities)
credit_loss_allowance.note: The originally-obvious ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses was retired when CECL changed credit-loss reporting and stops after 2018. Building on it would have produced a chart with no current data.

debt_to_equity.label: Debt-to-Equity (gross)
debt_to_equity.note: Total liabilities over stockholders' equity. See caveats.

caveats.headline: Gross leverage overstates what Redwood is liable for
caveats.detail: GAAP consolidates securitisation entities whose creditors have no claim on Redwood Trust, Inc. Gross debt-to-equity reached 29.86x in CY2026Q2; recourse leverage - counting only debt the parent can be pursued for - was 4.84x. The honest caveat on the caveat: recourse leverage has still nearly doubled since 2024, and part of that is equity shrinking rather than borrowing growing.

caveats.headline: The 2026 build is one asset, not a portfolio
caveats.detail: Effectively the entire $9.9M half-year build is a re-mark of a single retained interest in the Legacy Trust, a wind-down vehicle. The rollforward is explicit that no new securities entered an allowance position. Ring-fenced and shrinking by design.
